# Component index

**The community index has been deprecated.** With the release of the new Carbon
platform, the community index on this site is no longer available. A new
component discovery experience is available through the Carbon platform. See
below for more details.

## Discover assets

Use the new asset catalogs on the
[Carbon platform](https://next.carbondesignsystem.com/) to find components,
patterns, functions, and templates that once lived here in the community index.
